about: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash EXL3 3.0bpw on one RTX 3090: all routed experts pinned in RAM, staged-DMA prefill with FP16 GEMM for busy experts, AVX2 CPU tier for decode misses, elastic VRAM expert cache, Engram tables mmap'd from NVMe (dsv41-flash-offload 2e9da5e, campaign run D119)
setup: NEEDS (measured on the running D119 server, README 'Host requirements'): 1x 24 GB sm_86 GPU (RTX 3090; 21,852 MiB in use at ready, the VRAM expert mirror cache takes what is left minus 900 MB; nothing else may use the GPU); host RAM: container anonymous 194.0 GiB (pinned experts 190.5 GiB + process), container peak incl. Engram page cache 212.1 GiB / 227.8 GB -> a 256 GiB host (30 GB buffer); an x86-64 CPU with AVX2+FMA+F16C and >= 24 cores (CPU expert tier pinned to cores 2-23, 22 threads: DSV41_CT_CPUS / DSV41_CT_THREADS); NVMe: 457.9 GB of inputs + image (Mia EXL3 3.0bpw 219.3 GB, Engram shards 47-48 of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 203.1 GB read on demand while serving, overlay pack 2.9 GB, image 32.6 GB) -> 488 GB free (1 TB drive); run with --cap-add IPC_LOCK --ulimit memlock=-1. ONE-TIME PACK: with both weight dirs under one root mounted read-write at /models, run the image with the single argument `prepare` (GPU, a few minutes): it builds /models/DSV41-EXL3-3090-D010 (symlinks into the two weight dirs, FP16 wo_a and compressor/indexer projections, text-only V4.1 config, host-plan.json) and checks it against the measured pack's sha256; serving then mounts /models read-only. IMAGE: not published yet; build docker/Dockerfile of the source at this commit (pins lazymio/vllm-backport v0.13.0 by digest + Ampere V4.1 patches fae324ae + exllamav3 5be88657 + vllm-exl3 d3cfd394; runtime patches checked against the measured runs' sha256 receipts). ghcr.io/0xsero/dsv41-flash-offload from 0xSero/local-ai-images#12 replaces this build with a digest + provenance after merge and a release-image run on main. MEASURED (campaign run D119 = this launch: --max-model-len 262144, --kv-cache-memory 1.5 GiB = 297,224 fp8 KV tokens (1 GiB is refused at 262144), 16k chunks, staged-DMA prefill + FP16 GEMM, CPU tier, elastic VRAM expert cache; EPYC 7443P, 503 GiB DDR4, PCIe 4.0 x16, 990 PRO; bench/ctx_scan.py: TTFT prefill + inter-token decode, C1, natural EOS, no max_tokens; captured 2026-10-02 12:48-13:25 CEST; https://github.com/0xSero/dsv41-flash-offload/blob/2e9da5ecdab37c232c2da887e25c33a99da738d3/results/D119/ctx_scan.json and https://github.com/0xSero/dsv41-flash-offload/blob/2e9da5ecdab37c232c2da887e25c33a99da738d3/results/D119/ctx_scan_261k.json): prompt 8,192: prefill 589.1 / decode 16.38 tok/s; 32,768: 774.6 / 19.42; 65,536: 813.2 / 20.51; 131,072: 791.4 / 20.91; 196,608: 781.1 / 20.48; 261,000: 764.1 / 20.59. Earlier steps (P2 sweep at --max-model-len 65536, results/<run>/sweep.json): D030 baseline prefill 93.4 / 95.8, decode C1 4.10; D107 (1,024-token chunks) C1 21.34 / C2 26.27 / C4 28.30 agg; D061 prefill 565.2 / 744.9; D117 (non-elastic cache) 575.2 / 765.5, C1 15.55. Concurrency (C2/C4) at 262144 not measured. QUALITY: prefill of the staged-DMA path vs the D026 full-vocabulary reference (12 prompts, 416 positions): top-1 0.9856, mean KL 0.0068 nats, median 2.8e-6 - fails the campaign's inherited guard (top-1 >= 0.988, KL <= 0.00103); EXL3_DMA_GEMM=0 is the slower segmented path (results/D061/fidelity-verdict.json). NOT VALIDATED: the lab gates (load chat reasoning tools context speed) have not run; the deepseek_v41 tool and reasoning parsers are configured, not verified by the lab.
